description: It creates a public test address at webhook.site. Only fabricated sample payloads go there, never participant data. Anyone with the link can read the sample, and the address stops working after a few hours. Take it when a host wants to see a webhook work before it points at something real. "Can I try this without touching my CRM?" It creates a new address at that third-party service and changes nothing on the connected site. Every call creates a new address, and an earlier one stays valid. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect. Side effect: it creates a new public test address at webhook.site. Words hosts use: webhook test, test address, try webhook, no account
